gloss: the other party; on the other hand

definitions.gloss: the other party, the other side
definitions.explanation: Refers to the other person or group in a situation involving two parties.
Used as a conjunctive expression to introduce a contrasting or alternative viewpoint. More formal than 一方 in this sense.

examples.japanese: {他方|たほう}の{意見|いけん}も{聞|き}くべきだ。
examples.english: We should also listen to the other party's opinion.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}の{他方|たほう}の{当事者|とうじしゃ}に{通知|つうち}する。
examples.english: Notify the other party to the contract.

examples.japanese: {一方|いっぽう}では{賛成|さんせい}、{他方|たほう}では{反対|はんたい}の{声|こえ}がある。
examples.english: There are voices in favor on one hand and against on the other.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}は{成長|せいちょう}した。{他方|たほう}、{格差|かくさ}も{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The economy grew. On the other hand, inequality also widened.

examples.japanese: この{政策|せいさく}には{利点|りてん}がある。{他方|たほう}、{課題|かだい}も{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: This policy has advantages. On the other hand, there are also considerable challenges.

examples.japanese: {都市部|としぶ}では{人口|じんこう}が{増|ふ}えているが、{他方|たほう}、{地方|ちほう}では{減少|げんしょう}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The population is increasing in urban areas, but on the other hand, the decline continues in rural areas.

notes:
Often used in formal writing and academic contexts. When used as a conjunction, it typically appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause to present a contrasting point. Frequently paired with {一方|いっぽう} (one side/on one hand) in the pattern 一方では…他方では… (on one hand... on the other hand...).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{一方|いっぽう}では…{他方|たほう}では… (on one hand... on the other hand...)
・{他方|たほう}、〜 (on the other hand, ~)
